item.title: JENNIE Debuts Unreleased Songs at Open’er Festival, Teases New Music ‘Soon’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our music update! We've got some exciting news to share with you. BLACKPINK's JENNIE just headlined the final night of Open'er Festival in Poland, and she's got new music on the way.
[Music transitions to a short clip of JENNIE's music]
Host: JENNIE performed a 17-track set, including three unreleased songs: "Lock It Down", "Heaven", and "Less Than A Lover". The latter is a dreamy ballad inspired by summer, and she told the crowd it feels special to share new music with her fans.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: JENNIE's set also featured songs from her debut solo album "Ruby", as well as her collaborations with Tame Impala and The Weeknd. And speaking of collaborations, her song "Dracula" with Tame Impala has been a huge hit, reaching number one on Billboard's Pop Airplay chart and peaking at number 10 on the Billboard Hot 100.
[Music transitions to a short clip of "Dracula"]
Host: JENNIE's been on a roll, with her album "Ruby" debuting at number 7 on the Billboard 200 and producing five Hot 100 entries. She's also logged six total Hot 100 entries as a soloist, the most of any female K-pop solo act. And her album "Ruby" has surpassed 3 billion Spotify streams.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: That's all for today's music update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!
[Outro music plays]
